messages:
Alex: Heads-up — we're getting a spike in routing-fallback-rate for prod. Alerts from the console started ~10m ago.
Maya: Yep, saw it. Traffic looks like it's bouncing across regions (us-east -> eu-west -> ap-southeast) before finally succeeding. Fallback count is much higher than usual.
Kevin: Quick look at logs shows repeated attempts per request. Seems model variant fallback + cross-region routing are interacting. Example trace: 
```
2026-03-17T14:02:10Z router: req=abc123 region=us-east model=redwood/large v1 -> capacity=busy fallback-> model=redwood/large-quant region=eu-west attempt=1
2026-03-17T14:02:11Z router: req=abc123 region=eu-west model=redwood/large-quant -> capacity=burst fallback-> model=redwood/large region=ap-southeast attempt=2
2026-03-17T14:02:12Z router: req=abc123 region=ap-southeast model=redwood/large -> success attempt=3
```
This sequence explains the amplification (each fallback spawns another cross-region hop).
SRE-Bot: Incident created: INC-8421 (created by router-monitor). Paging oncall.
Jamie: I think the root is the elastic_fallback policy combined with route_on_capacity: true. We don't have a max_fallback_attempts guard so requests can be retried multiple times across regions.
Liam: I can push a hotfix to control-plane: set route_policy.elastic_fallback.max_attempts=1 and disable cross_region_fallback for non-enterprise customers. Pushing now.
Maya: Also please add a short-term throttle: limit fallback retries per source IP/customer to 5/min so one noisy tenant doesn't amplify cluster-wide.
Kevin: Long-term: add circuit breaker on variant fallback and a TTL on per-request fallback state so the router won't retry the same request across regions after X seconds. Also add a dedicated metric: multi_hop_fallback_count. Current "fallback_count" is too coarse.
Alex: Pushed the policy change to disable cross-region fallback for Silver/Free tiers and set max_attempts=1 for Bronze/Silver. Monitoring.
SRE-Bot: Config rollout started -> control-plane.apply(config=route-policy-20260317-01)
Jamie: Can someone update the Console dashboards? We need a graph with: 
- fallback_rate by region
- multi_hop_fallback_count (new)
- avg_attempts_per_request (new)
Also add an alert if avg_attempts_per_request > 1.5 for >5min.
Liam: Dashboards updated (temporary tab) and alert rule created: router.avg_attempts > 1.5 for 5m -> pager.
Maya: After the change fallback-rate dropped ~78% and cross-region egress dropped massively. Will keep watch for 30m.
Kevin: Filed RFC-317: "Router fallback circuit-breakers + per-request path tracing". Includes proposed telemetry changes and suggested UX: a per-rollout toggle in Console to opt into cross-region fallback with warnings.
Alex: Nice. Follow-up tasks: (1) add multi_hop_fallback_count to long-term retention, (2) implement max_attempts fail-open only for enterprise, (3) add rollout UX warning & opt-in. I'll assign in JIRA.
Jamie: Thanks team. Closing the immediate incident once stable for 1h.
Liam: Note for postmortem: include a tiny example in docs of how fallback policies interact with route_on_capacity so engineers know the amplification risk.
SRE-Bot: Incident INC-8421 status -> resolved (mitigated); follow-up tasks created: RFC-317, DASH-122, ROUTE-2026.
